meta.title: DriveOS | Software for auto repair shops
meta.description: DriveOS connects OBD-II diagnostics, work orders, inventory and electronic invoicing for your shop in a single system.

hero.title: Your shop, one step ahead of the failure.
hero.sub: DriveOS reads each vehicle's diagnostics, organizes work orders and invoices SUNAT from one system.

problem.statement: Today's shop waits for the car to fail. Tomorrow's shop already knows.
problem.detail: Paper orders, missing parts and customers who never return. One digital flow puts it all in order.

0.title: Plug in the scanner
0.text: Any OBD-II device sends readings and fault codes to the system.

1.title: Get the alert
1.text: Rules detect out-of-range values and warn you before the breakdown.

2.title: Open the order
2.text: The technician logs tasks, photos and time, even without a connection.

3.title: Charge and invoice
3.text: Parts are deducted by batch and the receipt goes out to SUNAT.

features.title: The whole shop in one system

telemetry.title: Telemetry from any scanner
telemetry.text: PID readings and DTC codes arrive in real time, whatever the brand of the OBD-II device.

evidence.title: Orders with evidence
evidence.text: Immutable photos at intake, repair and delivery back up every job.

fifo.title: FIFO inventory
fifo.text: Each part leaves from the oldest batch and the real cost is recorded.

sunat.title: SUNAT invoicing
sunat.text: Electronic receipts and invoices from the settled order, in under 2 minutes.

offline.title: Work offline
offline.text: The technician keeps working in the pit when the internet drops. Everything syncs when the signal returns.

items.0: Orders, schedule and bays on one board

technician.lead: Less typing, more time on the car.

items.0: Tasks and time from the phone

trust.title: Built to keep running
trust.note: Design targets defined in the project architecture.

0.text: Telemetry bursts are absorbed without slowing down the shop's operation.

1.text: Each shop reaches only its own data, with tenant isolation.

2.text: No record is lost during the outage and everything syncs on return.

basic.name: Basic

pro.name: Pro
pro.text: Several locations, more users and higher telemetry volume.
